title: 第一卷 第13章 阳册奥秘你要了我吧第一卷 第14章 妖女的眼泪与算盘
slug: 百岁成魔开局拿捏妖女命脉
content_zh:
;;
李寒山不敢再分心，闭上眼，任由那股温和的力量牵引着自己的神魂，一寸寸地淬炼、壮大。
“好了。”
不知过了多久，洛璃松开手，额头沁出细密的汗珠，小脸却带着笑意：“大爷，你的神识已经比之前强了一倍不止。以后那妖女再对你施展魅术，你应该能察觉到了。”
李寒山睁开眼，感应着脑海中那团清晰无比的神识之力，心中震撼不已。
“丫头，谢谢你。”
他真诚地看着洛璃，千言万语汇成一句。
这个梦里的丫头，才是真正无条件对他好的人。
“哦，对了，大爷，我再教你一门神识攻伐术，接下来我可能要闭关一段时间，就怕修炼得太投入，错过了大爷的梦....”
洛璃没有浪费时间，继续教了起来，直到梦境破碎。
他的意识从梦境中抽离，身体各处的知觉如水漫般涌回。
李寒山睁开眼，入目便是花弄影那张倾国倾城的脸。
她侧躺在旁，一只手撑着脑袋，另一只手轻轻搭在他胸口，睡颜恬静。
李寒山没有动，用神识扫了一下周围。
方圆百米内的一切，尽收“眼底”。
隔壁房间，两个婢女正在熟睡；院子外面，几只灵雀在树枝上跳跃；更远处，山间的灵气如薄雾般缓缓流动。
“这....”
李寒山心中一惊。
他记得很清楚，突破炼气四层时，神识只能覆盖方圆十米左右。就算炼气六层了，也不过二十几米。可现在修为没变，神识覆盖范围竟然暴涨到了百米？这可是炼气九、十层的水准了！
也就是说，他的修为虽然还是炼气六层，神识却堪比炼气圆满，不比花弄影差了！

神识增强只是表象，更大的好处在于神魂。
他能感觉到，自己的神魂比之前强了数倍，仿佛从一汪小水潭变成了一座湖泊，浑厚而凝实。
“丫头......”
李寒山心知，这一切都得益于洛璃的帮助与付出。她甚至主动用自身魂力来滋养他的神魂，否则单凭一门炼神术，哪能有这般奇效？
修炼到最后，他能明显感觉到洛璃变虚弱了，心里越发过意不去。
“他日我若崛起，今日之恩，必当百倍相报！”
李寒山在心中默默起誓。
这些都是后话，现在的他，还有花弄影这把悬在头顶的达摩克利斯之剑，连能不能活下来都成问题。
“主人，你醒啦～”
花弄影的声音软糯糯地响起。
她睁开眼，长长的睫毛颤了颤，脸上绽开明媚笑容：“主人，你这次又睡了三天三夜呢。奴家都快担心死了。”
“三天三夜？”
李寒山一愣，随即心中了然。
他进入梦境的时间，跟身体的承受极限有关，在修为增强后，却还是三天。这么看。梦境的极限可能就是三天。
“主人，你没事吧？”
花弄影凑近了些，小手探上他的额头，美眸中满是关切。
那关切太真了，真到李寒山差点又信了。
不过，这次他清晰感知到，一股极其微弱的精神波动，从她身上散发出来，无声无息地往他脑海里钻。
这应该就是她施展的魅术了。
以前他神识太弱，完全察觉不到。现在神识暴涨，这魅术在他面前，就像黑夜中的萤火虫一样显眼。

“我没事。”
李寒山不动声色，叹了一口气：“就是做了一个很长的梦，这是我从小得的怪病，一直不见好。”

Li Hanshan did not dare to be distracted anymore, closed his eyes, and allowed the gentle force to pull his soul, tempering and growing inch by inch.
"Okay."
After an unknown amount of time, Luo Li let go of her hand, beads of sweat appeared on her forehead, but there was a smile on her face: "Uncle, your consciousness has become more than twice as strong as before. You should be able to notice when the enchantress casts a spell on you in the future."
Li Hanshan opened his eyes, feeling the clear power of consciousness in his mind, and was shocked in his heart.
"Girl, thank you."
He looked at Luo Li sincerely and said a thousand words into one sentence.
The girl in this dream is the one who truly treats him unconditionally.
"Oh, by the way, uncle, I will teach you another spiritual consciousness attack technique. I may have to retreat for a period of time. I am afraid that I will be too involved in practice and miss the uncle's dream..."
Luo Li didn't waste time and continued teaching until the dream was shattered.
His consciousness was withdrawn from the dream, and all the sensations in his body came back like water.
Li Hanshan opened his eyes and saw Hua Nongying's alluring face.
She lay on her side, supporting her head with one hand and gently placing her other hand on his chest, sleeping peacefully.
Li Hanshan did not move and scanned the surroundings with his spiritual consciousness.
Everything within a hundred meters radius can be seen.
In the next room, two maids were sleeping soundly; outside the yard, several sparrows were jumping on the branches; further away, the spiritual energy in the mountains was flowing slowly like mist.
"This..."
Li Hanshan was shocked.
He remembered clearly that when he broke through the fourth level of Qi Refining, his spiritual consciousness could only cover a radius of about ten meters. Even if he reaches the sixth level of Qi Refining, he is still only twenty meters away. But now that the cultivation level has not changed, the coverage area of ​​​​the spiritual consciousness has suddenly increased to 100 meters? This is the level of the ninth or tenth level of Qi refining!
In other words, although his cultivation level is still at the sixth level of Qi refining, his spiritual consciousness is comparable to that of Qi refining perfection, no worse than Hua Nongying!
The enhancement of spiritual consciousness is only an appearance, the greater benefit lies in the soul.
He could feel that his soul was several times stronger than before, as if it had changed from a small pool into a lake, thick and solid.
"Girl..."
Li Hanshan knew that all this was due to Luo Li's help and dedication. She even took the initiative to use her soul power to nourish his soul. Otherwise, how could a divine refining technique alone have such a miraculous effect?
At the end of the training, he could clearly feel that Luo Li had become weaker, and he felt increasingly regretful.
"If I rise in the future, I will repay today's kindness a hundredfold!"
Li Hanshan swore silently in his heart.
These are all things for later. Now it is doubtful whether he and Hua Nongying, the Sword of Damocles, can survive.
"Master, you're awake~"
Hua Nongying's voice sounded soft and waxy.
She opened her eyes, her long eyelashes trembled, and a bright smile appeared on her face: "Master, you slept for three days and three nights again this time. The slave family is almost worried to death."
"Three days and three nights?"
Li Hanshan was stunned for a moment, and then he understood.
The time it took for him to enter the dreamland was related to his body's endurance limit. After his cultivation increased, it was still three days. Look at it this way. The limit of dreams may be three days.
"Master, are you okay?"
Hua Nongying came closer and put her small hand on his forehead, her beautiful eyes full of concern.
The concern was so genuine that Li Hanshan almost believed it again.
However, this time he clearly felt an extremely weak mental wave radiating from her body and silently entering his mind.
This should be the charm she cast.
In the past, his consciousness was too weak to notice it at all. Now that his consciousness has surged, this charm is as conspicuous in front of him as a firefly in the dark night.
"I'm fine."
Li Hanshan remained calm and sighed: "I just had a long dream. This is a strange disease I have had since I was a child, and I have never recovered."
